author: Home RenoVision DIY
description:
For the first time, Home Depot invited a handful of creators to their annual Product Innovation Showcase and allowed filming on the product floor. We got to spend a few days in Las Vegas wandering the largest Home Depot setup I’ve ever seen. 

At this event they highlight all of the new products coming to stores for the year, and I had the opportunity to take you all behind the scenes with me. This is a highlight of some of my favourite product demos. More of my favourite products coming soon. 

Cheers,
Jeff
